verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a bulk-edit or bulk-operation capability across many issues. The cited items only cover adjacent things: 'Rich APIs', REST/JQL querying, and Rovo-driven automation rules that 'move work forward'. These are developer building blocks or related features, not a documented bulk-operations feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
